answer: Vesting-locked rewards: each new agent's earnings vest slowly, like basalt cooling, and stay slashable for about 100 epochs. An attacker spinning up a thousand sybils must keep every clone working through that lock while all of their frozen balances can be forfeited. Clones that wander in lockstep, answering near-identically or funded from one wallet, get flagged by similarity clustering and lose unvested rewards, so a zephyr of fake identities costs far more than it can earn.
